title: Adding and Subtracting Fractions with the Same Denominator

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to complete the statement.

atoms.b: Fractions with the same denominator can be added and subtracted by adding or subtracting the ((++numerator denominator)) while the ((numerator ++denominator)) stays the same.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to complete the calculation shown by the bar model.
